text:
Anita (CS): quick heads-up — our weekly commit burn check flagged an unusual spend pattern for AcmeCorp on hosted API. Posting summary below, please weigh in if this looks like legit growth vs anomaly.

billing-bot: Automated summary for AcmeCorp (project: acme-prod)
```
Acct: AcmeCorp
Commit: $20,000/month
Weekly burn (this week): $8,620
Projected month run-rate: $34,480
Anomaly: +72% vs rolling 4-week avg
Primary endpoint: /v1/generate (hosted)
Top model: redwood-2-small-quant
Avg latency: 220ms (p50), 1.8s (p95)
Error rate: 0.9% (up from 0.1%)
Possible causes: token spike, retry storms, batch misconfig
```

Tom S: :eyes: that's a big delta. Any known product changes or campaigns?

Anita (CS): not that I'm aware of. CS notes increased onboarding tests last week but nothing prod-scale. I asked acct owner for recent rollout notes.

Soren G: seeing increases in tokens per request for that tenant in traces — median input tokens up from ~120 to ~820 for a subset of calls. Likely an internal batch embedding job hitting the hosted endpoint by mistake.

Evelyn: tagging ops-alerts to check for retry storms or CI jobs accidentally using API keys. @ops-alerts can you surface any spikes in 5xx or auth errors?

ops-alerts: Alert dump for acme-prod between 2026-03-17 00:00 and 2026-03-20 08:00:
- 5xx spikes correlated to p95 latency jumps at 03-18 14:02
- several 429 bursts around 03-18 14:05 from same API key
- repeated 401s from two distinct IPs (likely test keys)
Suggest rotating keys + rate-limiting for onboarding envs.

Anita (CS): next steps proposal:
- immediate: tag account as "investigate" for billing team and set soft quota at 120% of commit to avoid runaway charges.
- ops: rotate any test keys and enable stricter rate-limit for keys flagged as "sandbox".
- CS: schedule a quick call with acct owner to confirm background jobs and pause any large batches.

Tom S: agree. Also recommend temporary model fallback to a cheaper variant (redwood-2-micro) for non-prod traffic — reduces token cost and help with latency.

Soren G: will push a routing rule to divert requests from keys flagged as sandbox to cheaper model (canaries only) — doing that now.

billing-bot: Note added to account: "Flagged for overspend investigation; soft quota applied at $24,000/month. Contact: Anita (CS)."

Evelyn: I've scheduled a 15-min sync with the customer for tomorrow 9:00am PT. I'll share quick mitigation checklist: rotate keys, review background jobs, consider model/prompt optimizations.

Anita (CS): thanks everyone. I'll update thread after the sync and mark whether this was anomalous or a true usage increase. :thumbsup:
